sql: with t as ( select pt.market_ticker, pt.pnl, m.event_ticker, substring(m.event_ticker from position('-' in m.event_ticker)+1) as contest from paper_trades pt join mmsell_settlement_meta m on m.market_ticker = pt.market_ticker where pt.strategy = 'mmsell10' and pt.status in ('settled','closed_sl') and pt.created_at >= timestamptz '2026-08-13 18:09:40+00' and m.event_ticker is not null ) select contest, count(*) as trades, count(distinct split_part(event_ticker,'-',1)) as distinct_series, count(distinct event_ticker) as distinct_events, round(sum(pnl)::numeric,2) as pnl from t group by contest order by count(*) desc limit 25
